title: Crates screen — before
caption: Before: a small crate by the title, a Base/Yours odds table with L1/L2/L3 jargon and "kinds", a sample shelf, a torn duplicate slip, nothing saying where crates come from, a dead gap above the CTA.

title: Opening — before
caption: Before: Open was a card that popped in above the odds — no moment at all.

title: Crates screen — v1 (superseded)
caption: After: one column, no tabs. The big pixel crate with how many your bank buys (×4) and where crates come from; one framed panel — the three levels as Codex tiles with their chance, New to you, what a duplicate becomes; how many to open; Open a crate · 500.

title: Crates screen — bank short
caption: A short bank: no count, the refusal in red ("180 gold short"), the CTA off.

title: Home Crates plate — after (3×)
caption: The Crates plate wears the sealed crate itself (16 × 12, at the sheet's double like every mark) and a count badge: how many the bank buys. Before: the generic loot chest.

title: Home Crates plate — before (3×)
caption: Before: the atlas loot chest, no count.

title: The opening — two crates (WebP)
caption: Drop and thud, three taps (the glow climbs to teal at the second), burst: lid off, flash, the pack's explosion, rays, coins. A Level 2 card flips, then the Level 3 builds up longer and flips with a hit-stop, shake and a gold ring. Summary, Collect.

title: The opening — a Level 1 (WebP)
caption: A common reward: a short build-up, a small burst, no shake — the ladder has room to climb.

title: The opening — a Level 3 (WebP)
caption: The big beat: the longest build-up, the card trembling, a held breath, then a gold flash, a screen shake and two gold rings.

title: Burst frame
caption: The lid flies off sideways, the seal breaks, the explosion strip and coins over a purple ray burst (the best reward's level).

title: Level 3 flip, at 3×
caption: Whole pixels at 3×: the gold ring, the flash, the plum frame with its gold rim.

title: Summary
caption: Everything won as Codex tiles (level plate, NEW) and the one CTA, Collect.

title: Desk
caption: The screen on a desk: the same column; level tiles go wide.

title: Desk — the opening
caption: The opening on a desk: bigger stage pixels (4 px), the card grows with the screen.

title: Odds — before / after
caption: The designer: the preview read as winning those exact items. Now each level is a mystery card — its frame, a "?", its chance and how many of its kinds are new to you. No item is pictured.

title: Chest directions
caption: Four directions in the real screen: A one chest on stage, B Clash Royale slots, C Supercell shop bundles, D the chest grows with how many you open. D chosen: one hero, and the count is something you see.

title: Crates screen — v2
caption: The hero chest on its plinth, lit and alive, ×3 on a gold ribbon that steps it, one quiet line on where crates come from, the abstract odds, Open 3 crates.

title: Chest sizes · 1 / 3 / 5
caption: The chest grows with the count: a rope-lashed wooden crate, the iron-banded crate, a gold-trimmed chest. Presentation only — still one openCrate per crate.

title: The chest idle (WebP, 3 s)
caption: Breathing glow and halo, light at the lid seam, the seal pulsing, motes drifting, a rattle between hops, slow rays. Light halves it; reduced motion holds it still.

title: The opening — v2 (WebP)
caption: Coins stream from the price into the chest, it hops, and the opening starts from that chest (here two crates: the wooden one).
